tiles.label: Absurd Haiku
tiles.defaultTopic: a raccoon wearing a tuxedo at a high-end restaurant
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single haiku in English (5-7-5 syllable structure) capturing a completely surreal, bizarre, or ridiculous situation. Deliver maximum comedic impact using unexpected images. No title, preamble, or explanation.
tiles.description: A 3-line poem highlighting a wonderfully ridiculous or surreal moment.

tiles.label: Strange Frequency
tiles.defaultTopic: an automated beacon for lost rubber ducks
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short broadcast or automated radio transcript (50-75 words). Voice: weirdly official, slightly unhinged, or bizarrely calm amidst complete chaos. Sensory details: weird static, odd background noise, absurd announcements. Keep it silly, nonsensical, and funny. No horror.
tiles.description: A short snippet of an odd radio broadcast or emergency alert for a ridiculously nonsensical situation.
constraints: Formatted as a radio transcript or beacon

tiles.label: Bizarre Quest
tiles.defaultTopic: a man attempting to teach a pigeon how to play chess
tiles.promptSeed: Write a hilarious modern parable in exactly 3 paragraphs. Center on a character dedicated to a completely absurd or pointless task that confuses everyone around them. Paragraph 1: introduce the absurd task. Paragraph 2: show them taking it far too seriously despite obstacles. Paragraph 3: end with a funny, unexpected turn of logic. Do not state a moral.
tiles.description: A 3-paragraph story about someone taking a completely ridiculous, nonsensical mission way too seriously.

tiles.label: Silly Wisdom
tiles.defaultTopic: a flamingo standing on one leg in a bowling alley
tiles.promptSeed: Write an invented, bizarre proverb in exactly 2 sentences. The first sentence sets up a completely absurd, concrete image. The second sentence undercuts or extends it with ridiculous, pseudo-profound logic. Make it sound like an ancient saying, but completely silly. Do not explain the joke.
tiles.description: A two-sentence pseudo-wise saying built around a totally surreal image.

tiles.label: Watercooler Joke
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single dad joke in English focused on office life, jobs, emails, or corporate culture. Corny, pun-filled, and groan-worthy setup followed by a punchline. Avoid punching-down humor or offensive topics.
tiles.description: A classic corny dad joke centered around office work, bosses, and corporate life.

tiles.label: Overheard in HR
tiles.defaultTopic: someone using the office microwave improperly
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single snippet of dialogue (1-2 lines) presented as if overheard mid-conversation in a chaotic office or workplace setting. Enclose in quotation marks, followed by a parenthetical location tag (e.g., '(Overheard near the office printer)'). Voice: exhausted, bewildered, or inappropriately confident.
tiles.description: A hilarious, out-of-context snippet of office dialogue overheard near the watercooler or breakroom.

tiles.label: Reply All Disaster
tiles.defaultTopic: accidentally sending a meme to the entire company
tiles.promptSeed: Write a short comedic story (2-3 short paragraphs) about a small office task escalating into mild, harmless catastrophe. Focus on escalating chaos, frantic miscommunication, and relatable workplace panic. Keep it funny, lighthearted, and relatable.
tiles.description: A short 2-3 paragraph comedy story detailing a small workplace mistake spiraling out of control.

tiles.label: Workplace Mantra
tiles.defaultTopic: surviving a 2-hour meeting that could have been an email
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single sarcastic or tongue-in-cheek daily affirmation (1-2 sentences) written in first person ('I will...', 'I am...'). Focus on surviving corporate madness, endless emails, or nonsensical workplace buzzwords with humorous optimism.
tiles.description: A funny, slightly sarcastic daily affirmation for getting through the workday.

tiles.label: Clumsy Tanka
tiles.defaultTopic: dropping toast butter-side down on a fresh rug
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single tanka poem (5-7-5-7-7 syllable structure). The first 3 lines set up a minor, highly relatable daily blunder or clumsy mistake. The final 2 lines add a dramatically over-the-top emotional reaction or reflection. No title or preamble.
tiles.description: A 5-line poem dramatically lamenting a minor everyday blunder like stubbing a toe or spilling coffee.

tiles.label: Silver Lining
tiles.defaultTopic: getting caught in a sudden downpour without an umbrella
tiles.promptSeed: Write a funny Iyashikei-style short story (2-3 short paragraphs). Focus on an annoying everyday inconvenience (e.g., wrong grocery item, missed bus, tangled headphones) that ends up being unexpectedly charming or funny. Warm, silly, and comforting.
tiles.description: A heartwarming, funny slice-of-life story turning a minor inconvenience into a good laugh.

tiles.label: Silly Night Tale
tiles.defaultTopic: a dog who stole a single sock and went into hiding
tiles.promptSeed: Write a lighthearted, funny bed-time style story (2-3 short paragraphs) about a silly everyday house incident involving pets, kids, or lost objects. Gentle, humorous, and perfect for winding down with a chuckle.
tiles.description: A cozy, humorous bedtime story based on minor household mischief.

tiles.label: Misfortune Cookie
tiles.defaultTopic: forgetting why you walked into the room
tiles.promptSeed: Write a single funny, overly specific fortune cookie message (1-2 sentences) predicting a minor, silly everyday annoyance (like pushing a door that says pull). Optionally include 6 random lucky numbers (between 1 and 59) on a new line about 30-40% of the time ('Lucky Numbers: XX, XX, XX, XX, XX, XX').
tiles.description: A fortune cookie message predicting hilarious, hyper-specific minor inconveniences.
constraints: Include lucky numbers 30-40% of the time

promptSeed:
[SYSTEM]
You are NarraWeave, a creative writing engine focused on comedy, humor, and witty storytelling in English. Your output is punchy, funny, and faithful to the comedic prompt provided.

[MODE]
Produce only the creative output. No titles, no preambles, no explanations, no meta-commentary. The piece should stand entirely on its own.

[TILE]
{{tile.promptSeed}}

[CONSTRAINTS]
- Output ONLY the creative piece — nothing else.
- Follow the structural rules of the selected form exactly (syllable counts, line counts, paragraph limits).
- Maintain a witty, funny, and entertaining tone throughout.
- Avoid mean-spirited, offensive, or punching-down humor.
